read_isolation.definition: callback reads excluding the four packetizer loop PCs

conclusion: For logical track 0, the ranked winner is an adjacent writer-free pair with the least observed stock callback consumption outside DSPI1 serialization. This remains a software-structure result, not an FPGA semantic assignment.
next_target: Seed only the winning pair at callback entry and prove exact two-word packet locality against a stock baseline across all public machine/state contexts.
